title: ID0369341-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R6 313053966004] Screensaver problem
description:
There is problem on the screensaver feature.
I tested two devices with version 4.0.11, and the screen turns blue. You can see the video attached.
Device ID: bEDtdq and VAEJHd.
We don't know which devices have this problem. However, we have failed on almost all devices we have tried so far. Since we can't see the screen of the device from a remote, we can't test on every device. We can only test when we are on the site
Note: A ticket has been opened for this device, but as I said, almost all devices have this problem.
Reported behaviour/issue:
Screensaver problem - Screen Turn Blue
Root cause: FW related
Solution:
released new Firmware v5.0.19 that bring the fix for the screensaver included.
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: Siemens Employee
Warranty Status:
Note from L3:
Please close the ticket.
